about_the_game:
STORY

Your name is Worm! You're a young scavenger, making a living by digging through the dangerous, trash-filled wastes of the past. One night, some no-good rustlers steal your beloved pets. What the- Why on earth would they do that? Better gather up your motley crew of friends and figure out what's going on!

ABOUT THE DEMO

Garbageland: Bunker Boyz Bluez is a stand-alone preview of Garbageland, which is in active development! The demo takes place somewhere during the first act of the full game. However, the events that happen here have no bearing on the main plot. Consider it a DLC-style side story you can play for free!

This demo includes about half the playable characters of the full game, a preview of three areas, and several unique bosses you won't see in the full game!

FEATURES

  • Hand-drawn sticker book aesthetic

  • Challenging turn-based gameplay with elements of Breakout, billiards, and golf

  • Pit your enemies against each other and the environment in order to progress and uncover valuable salvage

  • Dynamic cast of characters with unique skills that encourage puzzle-style problem solving

  • Estimated playtime: 1.5 - 3 hours

short_description: A Breakout-style RPG about a magical, trash-filled future. Use the environment against your enemies and scavenge useful treasures from the past. Features a dynamic cast of characters with a lovingly hand-draw sticker-book aesthetic. Stand-alone side story demo of Garbageland!
